title: ClearAir Readiness and Coordination Analysis
summary: Sources confirm ClearAir readiness status as 'ready' with independent instrument batches. Coordination involves survey teams managing separate sensor acceptance. No Northline dependency exists. All evidence is dated 2026-09-05 and originates from a synthetic dataset with no independent verification.

findings.qualification: Both sources assert readiness; video-tx-002 explicitly states it is synthetic and unverified.

findings.claim: ClearAir instruments are a separate accepted batch with no Northline dependency
findings.qualification: Record confirms separation; transcript reiterates no dependency recorded.

findings.claim: Coordination involves survey teams managing sensor acceptance
findings.qualification: Transcript describes coordination roles but notes lack of actual recording.

limitations: All evidence derives from a synthetic dataset with no independent verification.
Video-tx-002 explicitly states no video or audio was processed.
No external corroboration exists for ClearAir readiness claims.
follow_up: Future analysis should address fixture coverage for real-world ClearAir data.
Recommendation: Await qualified real data to validate synthetic readiness claims.
